ApplicationCreate.title: ApplicationCreate
ApplicationCreate.description:
Either `job_id` (canonical opportunity — the server snapshots its fields) or
a manual entry with at least `company` and `job_title`.

ApplicationUpdate.title: ApplicationUpdate
ApplicationUpdate.description:
Partial update; only fields present in the request are applied (an explicit
null clears an optional field). Opportunity fields are editable only on manual
applications — the service rejects them for dataset applications.

AssistantResponse.title: AssistantResponse
AssistantResponse.description:
The API's response to a sent message — the freshly created assistant
`MessageOut` plus the conversation's resulting active context, so the frontend
never has to re-fetch the whole conversation just to know what job/resume the
assistant is now tracking.
